summaryTab.matchStory: Sri Lanka built a commanding first-innings platform of 338, spearheaded by LD Chandimal's brilliant 138. Bangladesh replied strongly with 467, powered by Shakib Hasan's commanding century (116) to swing the contest. Sri Lanka added 319 in their second innings led by FDM Karunaratne's masterclass (126) to seize control. Bangladesh held their nerve in the fourth-innings chase, reaching the target to seal a famous victory.

summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at P Sara Oval commenced with high tactical intensity as Sri Lanka posted 338/10 (113.3 ov) in their opening innings. In response, Bangladesh countered with 467/10 (134.1 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance. Early sessions tested batting resolve against disciplined seam movement, with both attacks striving to gain the upper hand on a developing surface.

The defining turning point arrived during Century: FDM Karunaratne 126 (244b), which irrevocably altered the trajectory of the match. As the match progressed through its pivotal middle stages, Shakib Hasan delivered a masterclass for Bangladesh (131 Runs & 6 Wkts), absorbing intense pressure and tilting the momentum decisively. Crucial partnership stands and incisive bowling spells broke the opposition's resistance, shifting the control share (Bangladesh 57%) and allowing Bangladesh to dictate terms heading into the decisive sessions.

Entering the final innings, Sri Lanka faced an uphill battle under unrelenting scoreboard pressure. Bangladesh's bowling unit, bolstered by HMRKB Herath (34 Runs & 7 Wkts), maintained relentless discipline and attacked the stumps relentlessly. Wicket clusters in the closing sessions dismantled any remaining resistance, sealing Bangladesh won by 4 wickets in comprehensive fashion.

Verdict: Bangladesh's triumph was built on superior pressure absorption, clinical execution during critical moments, and the ability to dominate key sessions. While Sri Lanka produced fighting phases, Bangladesh won the pivotal turning points and sustained higher tactical control across all five days to emerge as deserved victors.
